title.rendered: World Cup: Semi-final fixtures confirmed, date, time

content.rendered:
The 2026 FIFA World Cup semi-final line-up has been confirmed following Argentina’s 3-1 victory over Switzerland and England’s 2-1 win against Norway.

France became the first team to secure a place in the last four after defeating Morocco 2-0 on Thursday, before Spain joined them with a 2-1 victory over Belgium on Friday.

England booked their place on Saturday after Jude Bellingham scored twice in a 2-1 extra-time comeback victory over Norway in Miami.

The final semi-final berth went to defending champions Argentina, who defeated 10-man Switzerland 3-1 after extra time on Sunday.

Lionel Messi provided an assist before Julian Alvarez and Lautaro Martinez sealed victory late in the game.

The results set up two heavyweight semi-final clashes, with France facing Spain and England taking on Argentina.

England and Argentina will renew one of international football’s fiercest rivalries after both sides advanced from the quarter-finals.

The encounter will be their first World Cup meeting since the 2002 tournament.

2026 FIFA World Cup semi-final fixtures

Tuesday, July 14

  • France vs Spain
    • Time: 20:00
    • Venue: Dallas Stadium, Dallas

Wednesday, July 15

  • England vs Argentina
    • Time: 20:00
    • Venue: Atlanta Stadium, Atlanta

Remaining fixtures

Saturday, July 18

  • Third-place play-off
    • Losers of Semi-final 1 vs Losers of Semi-final 2
    • Time: 22:00
    • Venue: Miami Stadium, Miami

Sunday, July 19

  • Final
    • Winners of Semi-final 1 vs Winners of Semi-final 2
    • Time: 20:00
    • Venue: MetLife Stadium, New York/New Jersey
